newsitem.title: INDIA: At least 20 killed in India lorry crash.
newsitem.headline: At least 20 killed in India lorry crash.

text.p: At least 20 people were killed and 33 injured on Sunday when a lorry overturned in the southern Indian state of Karnataka, United News of India (UNI) said.
The news agency said the crash occurred near Byadgi, 300 km (190 miles) northwest of state capital Bangalore.
UNI quoted state police officials as saying 20 people died on the spot. Two of the injured were in critical condition. It did not say how many people the vehicle was carrying.
More than 50,000 people die in road accidents every year in India.
